TAL_DARK_DARK_SLAUGHTER.why: Dark Slaughter (Meld): while it stands inside its own Darkness, +1d6/1d8/1d10/1d12 by CL when it hits with Advantage or hits a creature that can't see it; doubled on a critical hit (combat/ext/tabik_dark.py).

TAL_SCOUNDREL_TWIST_THE_KNIFE.why: Once per turn, a successful Dirty Trick or Steal against a creature within reach adds one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against it (combat/ext/tabik_scoundrel.py).

TAL_SCOUNDREL_FOCUSING_THIEVERY.why: After a successful Dirty Trick or Steal, the Bonus Action "Focusing Thievery: regain Martial Focus" is offered that turn.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_CUT_AND_RUN.why: While holding Martial Focus, a successful Dirty Trick or Steal made with its Action gives half its Speed of movement, and the target makes no Opportunity Attack on it that turn.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_FILTHY_DISTRACTION.why: A successful Dirty Trick against a creature that could not see it: a real Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and -5 Passive Perception until the end of that creature's next turn (combat/ext/scoundrel_riders.py filthy_distraction, filed as a condition and read by the table's own Perception and Passive Perception readers).

TAL_UNMAKING_BLACK_VEIN_PALM.why: A Ruin Channel charged hit with an unarmed strike (an Internal Channel) adds 1d8; on a hit, the chosen rider (Black-Vein Palm: No Reactions / No Healing / Constitution Save Disadvantage, a free choice kept until changed); then 1 Black Vein Strain (combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_DEVOURING_DREGS.why: An Overdraw (or Execution Through the Fault) that reduces the target to 0 HP removes 1 Black Vein Strain; removing a Crack from the Channel instead is the GM's.

TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_HAND_ON_THE_WRIST.why: Response talent: when Flowing Response succeeds, the triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn (combat/ext/flowing_river.py).

TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_RIVER_TAKES_THE_SPEAR.why: Response talent: against a melee weapon attack, a Strength save; no Opportunity Attacks with that weapon until the start of its next turn, and on a failure its next attack with that weapon has Disadvantage.

TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_BEND_THE_BLADE.why: Response talent: expend Martial Focus and resolve the same attack roll against another creature within the attacker's reach; a hit has the attack's ordinary hit effects.

TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_EMPTY_STEP.why: Response talent: Flowing Response's step becomes 10 feet. (The Dodge clause, no Opportunity Attacks from any creature that missed, is the GM's.)

TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_EMPTY_BANK_EVASION.why: On a Dexterity save against a damaging effect it can see, expend Martial Focus: no damage on a success, half on a failure; the 10-foot move after a success is the GM's.

TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_REED_IN_STORM.why: A melee miss against it while it benefits from the Dodge action regains Martial Focus (if absent).

tianxia.path.qi_cultivation.feature.gold.why: Golden Core Form: the Form is a free choice at the start of a fight (Stable when none is chosen); Stable's Qi recovery, Circulating's Temporary HP after spending Qi, Reservoir's once-per-fight Bonus Action (combat/ext/qi_path.py).

tianxia.path.qi_cultivation.feature.doma.why: Domain Armament: Manifest (Bonus Action, 1 Qi), Domain Armament Attack in Assault Mode (a creature within 35 feet), Guard Mode's +2 AC against ranged attacks (combat/ext/qi_path.py).

tianxia.subpath.qi.ninpo_adept.feature.h.why: Once per creature turn on a qualifying unseen hit or after Shadow Step: +2d6 (CL17 3d6) of the triggering damage type. Choose after damage: move 5 feet without provoking, deny Reactions until your next turn, Advantage on your next Stealth check this turn, push or pull 5 feet, or Smoke Mark until your next turn. No action or resource cost; manual owners choose, AI uses its preference (combat/ext/tabik_ninpo.py).

tianxia.subpath.body.shinobi.feature.pre.why: Once per turn on an unarmed-strike hit, 1 Stamina: a Constitution save; on a failure the chosen effect ("Pressure-Point Strike: <choice>", No Reactions by default, or off), on a success no Reactions until the start of its next turn (combat/ext/tabik_ninpo.py).

foundation.ancient_desolate_sacred_body_.why: After an unarmed or melee weapon hit within 5 feet, 1 Golden Sea Pulse: + PB + CON modifier damage, then the chosen rider ("Saint-Body Rebuke: <rider>"; No Reactions by default, or off) (combat/ext/foundation_sacred_body.py).

tianxia.path.qi_cultivation.feature.gold.why: Once per turn, a Qi-powered ability costing 2 Qi or more refunds 1 Qi as it resolves (combat/ext/qi_path.py).

tianxia.path.qi_cultivation.feature.doma.why: Domain Armament Link: the Domain Armament Attack reaches a creature within 65 feet (control range 60, movement 30) at CL13 damage (combat/ext/qi_path.py); Remote Technique Origin is a GM line.
